stimulus:
You will hear two syllables, one after the other, in background noise.

Is the CONSONANT the same in both?

Y = same      N = different

The background noise is different every time; listen to the consonant only. Answer after the second syllable, as quickly as you can, on every trial. You will see whether you were right.

There are 324 trials in 4 parts, with a short break between parts.

Press the space bar to begin.
